episodes.title: From Cult to Combat to Live TV: D. Logan on Breaking Mental Prisons
episodes.description:
Content advisory: This episode includes discussion of suicidal thoughts and the effects of war, which may be difficult for some listeners. Please listen with care.

D. Logan grew up poor on Chicago's South Side inside a strict religious group: no birthdays, no holidays, no sports. At 18 he joined the Air Force to escape, then served two combat tours in Iraq and came home still at war inside. After hitting rock bottom, he decided to "take command", rebuilt his life with military-style planning, and became a live television director whose work includes the World Series, a Super Bowl and the Australian Open.

Omar and Logan talk about what trauma does to the body, forgiving a parent who did her best, why "neuroplasticity is real: you are not hardwired", the theater of the mind, and the two reasons most people never reach their goals.
